tools.name: get_outline
tools.description: Returns a compact structural skeleton (classes, functions, method signatures, first-line docstrings) of a source file or directory. Prefer over `Read` for files >200 lines when the goal is to understand *what's in* the file rather than edit it — typically 20-40x fewer tokens. Supported languages: python, go, typescript, tsx, javascript. Pass a directory for a multi-file outline; `recursive: true` walks subdirectories.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to a file or directory.

max_depth.description: Nesting depth for classes and functions. Default: 2.

include_docstrings.description: Include the first line of docstrings / JSDoc / Go comments.

include_private.description: Include private symbols (_leading underscore, `private` modifier, lowercase Go names).

recursive.description: If `path` is a directory, walk subdirectories.

tools.name: get_function
tools.description: Returns the full source of one function or method identified by dotted symbol path (`func_name`, `ClassName.method`, `outer.inner.fn`). Prefer over `Read` with offset/limit when you need exactly one function body — no line-counting needed, no surrounding noise. Returns all `variants[]` for Python `@overload` sets. Supported languages: python, go, typescript, tsx, javascript.

path.description: File containing the target function or method.

symbol.description: Symbol path: "func_name" or "ClassName.method_name" or "outer.inner.fn". For Python @overload, all variants are returned.

tools.name: get_class
tools.description: Returns one class / interface / Go struct with method signatures (and, optionally, bodies). Prefer over `Read` when you want the public API surface of a single type without the rest of the file. Default `include_bodies: false` — signatures only; flip to `true` only if you need implementations. Supported languages: python, go, typescript, tsx, javascript.

path.description: File containing the target class, interface, or struct.

include_bodies.description: Include full method bodies. Default: false — signatures only.

tools.name: get_imports
tools.description: Lists all imports of a file with `isStdlib` / `isThirdParty` / `isRelative` flags and best-effort path resolution for relative imports. Prefer over `Read` + `Grep 'import'` when you need to understand a file's dependencies. Supported languages: python, go, typescript, tsx, javascript.
